queries.name: columns
queries.sql:
SELECT table_schema,table_name,column_name,data_type,is_nullable,udt_schema,udt_name,numeric_precision,numeric_scale
FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema IN ('humanresources','person','production','purchasing','sales')
ORDER BY table_schema,table_name,ordinal_position

queries.name: constraints
queries.sql:
SELECT ns.nspname AS table_schema,cl.relname AS table_name,con.conname AS constraint_name,pg_get_constraintdef(con.oid) AS definition
FROM pg_constraint con JOIN pg_class cl ON cl.oid=con.conrelid JOIN pg_namespace ns ON ns.oid=cl.relnamespace
WHERE con.contype IN ('p','f') AND ns.nspname IN ('humanresources','person','production','purchasing','sales')
ORDER BY ns.nspname,cl.relname,con.conname
